THE BUILD

The thinking behind the page.

A useful project has to connect its interface to the visitor’s task.

Audience

People who need a clear path into Jabalpur Navratri Pandals and an interface they can understand quickly.

Experience

Clear area navigation, useful location details and accessible pages across devices.

Next iteration

Review real visitor feedback and refine the areas where people hesitate or need more context.

Interface decisions

Visitors need to find a pandal, understand its location and get directions without searching through unrelated information. Dedicated pages organize images and practical visiting details.

What I would keep refining

The directory brings local discovery and mobile navigation together, with area-based browsing and direct map links.
